joinedGroups.rule: square tables whose annotated boxes are at most 8 px apart; the smallest gap between tables NOT joined is 40 px, so the rule has no borderline case on this drawing
joinedGroups.notJoined: the two bistro pairs touch at a single point of their circles and each bistro has its own two chairs; they are NOT scored as a joined group either way
joinedGroups.chairRule: a chair belongs to a group when its annotated table is a member, or when it sits on the seam between two members (the annotation left those four chairs unassigned because they are equidistant from two tables - both of which are in the same group)
